o: Opens: “This Psalm is a genuine one of David, though…”
ch.s: Verses 1–7: “This Psalm is a genuine one of David, though extra, composed when he fought in single combat with Goliath. I was small among my brothers, and youngest in…”. People named: David, Goliath.
q: Read verses 1–7. What is happening, and what stands out to you most?
Read verse 1 slowly. What does it say about God, about people, and about how to live?
What does David’s part in this chapter teach you — as an example to follow or a warning to heed?
Where do you see the theme of war and conflict in this chapter, and how does it connect to the rest of Psalm 151?
What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?
ch.a: Write down three things this chapter shows about God and thank Him for each.
